settings.heading: Handmade sofas, made to order
settings.subheading: Design your perfect sofa in 150+ fabric colours. Free UK delivery, 3–4 weeks to your door.

settings.text: Built in Britain, delivered to your door
Every sofa is handmade in the UK from solid hardwood frames and top-grade foam. Choose from over 150 fabric colours across velvet, boucle, chenille and linen.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: 3 to 4 weeks for made-to-order sofas, free to UK mainland.

settings.question: Can I choose left or right hand?
settings.answer: Yes, on corner sofas you can pick left or right hand facing at checkout.

settings.question: Do you offer a warranty?
settings.answer: Yes, every sofa comes with a 2-year frame warranty.
